groups.activity: buy a complete set or vaulted relics

rows.label: Protea Prime set
rows.note: all four blueprints; usually the fastest vaulted route

rows.label: Vanguard M1
rows.alt: Axi P7/P8, Meso P17, or Neo P7 (Rare)

conditions: Protea Prime and every relic that contains her parts are vaulted. Missions and relic packs cannot supply her relics today.
All vaulted relics and component blueprints are tradeable. Check current player prices before choosing relics over a finished set.
Vanguard M1 and E1 are valuable alternatives because their Chassis and Neuroptics rarities are better than the normal relic options.
bonuses: A complete set avoids both relic-market availability and fissure RNG.
Trade chat and Warframe.Market are useful for comparing current set versus relic prices.

disclosures.title: vaulted means waiting or trading
disclosures.body: There is no mission farm for Protea Prime until a future Prime Resurgence rotation includes her. Her vault status and Varzia's inventory can change, so verify them before spending platinum.

groups.activity: bank Aya before a Protea rotation
groups.meta: Aya is for future Varzia stock

rows.label: Aya
rows.note: rough radshare budget; carries between rotations

conditions: Aya is untradeable and cannot be boosted, but it stays in inventory after a rotation ends.
Relic packs can produce Aya but never vaulted Protea relics.

disclosures.title: the rotation has no published queue
disclosures.body: Varzia changes stock every 28 days at 18:00 UTC, but future offerings are not announced far enough ahead to schedule Protea. Check the live Prime Resurgence page before acting.

conditions: The launch relic IDs are historical references only; Varzia sells a hand-picked subset when a frame returns. Confirm the actual IDs and part rarities in her shop.
Buy enough relics before the rotation closes. Aya-bought relics are tradeable and remain openable forever.
Regal Aya can buy the completed frame when available, but it is a real-money currency, not a farmable substitute for Aya.
bonuses: Use the Orbiter Relic Segment or Prime Resurgence Market tab to access Varzia without travelling to Mars.

rows.label: Protea Prime Neuroptics
rows.note: Uncommon; Radiant normally, Vanguard E1 Intact

conditions: Refine rare-part relics to Radiant. Four matching Radiant relics give a 34.4% chance of at least one Rare reward per run.
Use Intact relics for Common drops: their chance falls from 25.33% Intact to 16.67% Radiant.
A radshare requires all four players to bring the same relic at the same refinement level. Collect 10 Reactant before extracting.
bonuses: Recruit by exact relic name, or use a vaulted-relic community, to find matching relic owners.
Choose a squadmate's reward when it contains the needed part; every squad member may claim the same reward.

disclosures.title: do not solo-crack expensive relics
disclosures.body: Vaulted relics are scarce and the Chassis and Systems are Rare in their normal relics. A proper radshare spends four relics per squad run but dramatically improves each owner's expected result.

rows.label: Protea Prime Neuroptics
rows.note: 15,000 cr, 8 Neural Sensors, 10 Control Module, 250 Oxium, 3,750 Salvage

rows.label: Protea Prime Chassis
rows.note: 15,000 cr, 2 Argon Crystal, 8 Morphics, 1,200 Rubedo, 4,250 Ferrite

rows.label: Protea Prime Systems
rows.note: 15,000 cr, 2 Nitain Extract, 370 Cryotic, 875 Circuits, 4,800 Nano Spores

conditions: Components build in parallel. Keep a free Warframe slot available for the final claim.
